common.name: A Rival Appears!
common.desc: Select 1 face-up monster your opponent controls. Special Summon 1 monster from your hand that has the same Level as the selected monster.

common.name: Batteryman C
common.desc: If all "Batteryman C"(s) you control are in Attack Position, all Machine-Type monsters you control gain 500 ATK for each "Batteryman C" you control. If all "Batteryman C"(s) you control are in Defense Position, all Machine-Type monsters you control gain 500 DEF for each "Batteryman C" you control.

common.name: Conscription
common.desc: Excavate the top card of your opponent's Deck, and if it is a monster that can be Normal Summoned/Set, Special Summon it to your field. Otherwise, add that card to your opponent's hand.

common.name: Cyber Archfiend
common.desc: At the beginning of your Draw Phase, if you have no cards in your hand, draw 1 more card in addition to your normal draw. During your End Phase, if you have 1 or more card(s) in your hand, destroy this card.

common.name: Cybernetic Cyclopean
common.desc: While you have no cards in your hand, this card gains 1000 ATK.

common.name: Cycroid
common.desc: The most lovable and friendly of all the Vehicroids. It can arm itself with training wheels!

common.name: Des Croaking
common.desc: Activate only while you control 3 face-up "Des Frogs". Destroy all cards your opponent controls.

common.name: Des Frog
common.desc: When this card is Tribute Summoned, you can Special Summon "Des Frog"(s) from your hand or Deck up to the number of "T.A.D.P.O.L.E."(s) in your Graveyard.

common.name: Doitsu
common.desc: Once per turn, you can equip this card to a "Soitsu" you control, OR unequip it to Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. When equipped to a monster by this card's effect, that monster gains 2500 ATK. (A monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle, destroy this card instead.)

common.name: Dragon's Mirror
common.desc: Fusion Summon 1 Dragon Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by banishing Fusion Materials listed on it from your field or GY.

common.name: Drillroid
common.desc: Before damage calculation, if this card attacks a Defense Position monster: Destroy that monster.

common.name: Ebon Magician Curran
common.desc: During your Standby Phase, inflict 300 damage to your opponent for each monster they control.

common.name: Fusion Recovery
common.desc: Target 1 "Polymerization" in your GY, and 1 monster in your GY that was used as material for a Fusion Summon; add them to your hand.

common.name: Giant Kozaky
common.desc: If there is no face-up "Kozaky" on the field, destroy this card. If this face-up card is destroyed, inflict damage equal to the original ATK of this card to its current controller.

common.name: Gyroid
common.desc: Once per turn, this card cannot be destroyed by battle.

common.name: Indomitable Fighter Lei Lei
common.desc: If this card attacks, it is changed to Defense Position at the end of the Battle Phase. This card's battle position cannot be changed until the end of your next turn, except with a card effect.

common.name: Jerry Beans Man
common.desc: Jerry, a bean soldier, believes he is the strongest warrior in the world, but his true abilities are still untested.

common.name: Jetroid
common.desc: At the time this card is selected as an attack target by an opponent's monster, you can activate Trap Card(s) from your hand.

common.name: Mad Lobster
common.desc: A gourmet food renowned by the Dark World upper crust. It has sensational flavor.

common.name: Mechanical Hound
common.desc: While you have no cards in your hand, your opponent cannot activate Spell Cards.

common.name: Patroid
common.desc: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, you can look at 1 face-down card your opponent controls, then return it to its original position.

common.name: Poison Draw Frog
common.desc: When this face-up card on the field is sent to the Graveyard (unless it was attacked while face-down and destroyed by battle), you can draw 1 card.

common.name: Pot of Generosity
common.desc: Return 2 cards from your hand to your Deck. Then shuffle your Deck.

common.name: Prepare to Strike Back
common.desc: Each time your opponent declares a face-up Defense Position monster as an attack target, toss a coin and call it. If you call it right, change the targeted monster to Attack Position. If you call it wrong, the controller of this card takes damage equal to the amount that the ATK of the attacking monster is higher than the DEF of the attack target.

common.name: Protective Soul Ailin
common.desc: Once per turn, you can equip this card to an "Indomitable Fighter Lei Lei" you control, OR unequip it to Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. When equipped to a monster by this card's effect, you can change that monster's battle position once per turn. (A monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle, destroy this card instead.)

common.name: Shien's Spy
common.desc: Select 1 face-up monster you control to activate this card. Give control of the selected monster to your opponent until the End Phase of this turn.

common.name: Soitsu
common.desc: Apparently totally unreliable, he wonders if he has incredible potential.

common.name: Spiritual Earth Art - Kurogane
common.desc: Tribute 1 EARTH monster. Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower EARTH monster from your Graveyard, except the Tributed monster.

common.name: Spiritual Fire Art - Kurenai
common.desc: Tribute 1 FIRE monster; inflict damage to your opponent equal to that monster's original ATK.

common.name: Spiritual Water Art - Aoi
common.desc: Tribute 1 WATER monster; look at your opponent's hand, then send 1 card from their hand to the Graveyard.

common.name: Spiritual Wind Art - Miyabi
common.desc: Tribute 1 WIND monster, then target 1 card your opponent controls; place that card on the bottom of the Deck.

common.name: Steam Gyroid
common.desc: "Gyroid" + "Steamroid"

common.name: Steamroid
common.desc: If this card attacks an opponent's monster, this card gains 500 ATK during the Damage Step only. If this card is attacked by an opponent's monster, this card loses 500 ATK during the Damage Step only.

common.name: T.A.D.P.O.L.E.
common.desc: When this card you control is destroyed by battle and sent to your Graveyard, you can add any "T.A.D.P.O.L.E."(s) from your Deck to your hand.

common.name: Tyranno Infinity
common.desc: The original ATK of this card is the number of your banished Dinosaur-Type monsters x 1000.
